security.title: Security policy
security.warning: This space can see the user's credentials.
security.load_user_shell_profile_hint: Runs the user's ~/.zshrc inside the space.
security.share_keychain_hint: The space reads the user's saved passwords.
security.share_ssh_hint: The space uses the user's ~/.ssh keys.
security.inherit_process_env_hint: The app process variables pass to the shell.
security.block_destructive_commands_hint: Multishell blocks rm -rf /, fork bombs, mkfs, dd to disk and reset --hard before the shell sees them.
